statement: PREREGISTRATION_24 (square cylinder, W in {64, 96} columns, unit conductances; block-diagonal lateral Fourier decomposition of the explicit Jacobian, block and global rates for the vertical and horizontal edge columns). G1 PASS (union of block singular values equals the unblocked vertical-edge spectrum to 1.84e-15). G2 FAIL (global rates 1.65 (v W=64) and 1.67 (v W=96) against the explicit-SVD values 1.793 and 1.783 required within 0.08). P1 HELD (the block with the smallest sigma_min is the zigzag block i = W/2, q = pi, at depths 4 to 7 on both widths: i = 32 for W=64, i = 48 for W=96). P2 REFUTED (block rates at i = 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48 measured 0.996, 1.02, 1.12, 1.30, 1.48, 1.85 against predicted 1.02, 1.24, 1.42, 1.58, 1.72, 1.83). P3 HELD (horizontal global rate 1.76 against predicted global rate 1.83).
notes: experiments/track_h_hyperbolic_network/exp24_momentum_resolved_rates_on_the_cylinder.py. LIMITS: That the picture explains the disk's rates (disks have curvature, diagonal directions and graph-distance depth; the disk values 1.1-1.2 are below this cylinder value 1.83, which is itself a finding to explain); the triangular lattice (its straight periodic boundary is exactly degenerate, PREREGISTRATION_23.md); hyperbolic geometry; a proof of the Vandermonde asymptotics; anything about holography.
